newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak govt denies reports on finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Slovak govt denies reports on finance minister.

text.p: The Slovak government on Friday rejected local media reports that Finance Minister Sergej Kozlik was about to be replaced by director of the commercial bank Devin Banka a.s. Karol Martinka.
"The goverment has no such proposal, nothing like this is on its agenda," government spokeswoman Ludmila Bulakova told Reuters. Finance ministry officials refused to comment.
The independent daily SME on Friday carried an unsourced article saying Kozlik was about to be forced out, though he would retain his post of deputy prime minister for the economy.
"I cannot comment on this rumour, it is fully within the competence of the government to issue a statement on this matter," finance ministry spokeswoman Zuzana Brutenicova told Reuters.
Devin Banka officials were not immediately available for comment.
